system.name: Picsou
system.one_liner: a communication layer that lets replicated state machines exchange application messages efficiently using cumulative acknowledgments instead of per-message ACKs

content.subject: how 4 receiver replicas' message lists and cumulative-acknowledgment counters evolve over 5 time-steps as 8 messages arrive

elements.name: R21
elements.role: receiver replica 1, tracks which messages it has received and its cumulative ack count

elements.name: cumulative acknowledgment
elements.role: rightmost column (green) showing each receiver's highest fully-contiguous message count received so far

relations.what: message m1 arrives at and is listed by R21
the receiver's contiguous message prefix determines its reported ack count

panels.label: (a) Time-step 1
panels.differs: all lists are empty and every cumulative ack is 0

panels.label: (b) Time-step 2
panels.differs: R21 stores m1 (ack=1); R22 stores m2 and R23 stores m3, but their ack stays 0 since m1 is still missing

panels.label: (c) Time-step 3
panels.differs: an internal broadcast delivers m1-m4 to every receiver, so all four cumulative acks jump to 4

panels.label: (d) Time-step 4
panels.differs: R21/R22/R23 each receive one more message (m8/m5/m6) but only R22's is contiguous (m1-m5), so only its ack advances to 5

panels.label: (e) Time-step 5
panels.differs: the internal broadcast disseminates all remaining messages so every receiver holds m1-m8 and every ack reaches 8

values.what: which of 8 messages (m1..m8) each of 4 receivers (R21-R24) has received by each time-step, and the resulting cumulative acknowledgment count
values.linked_by: position, the same message label repeated in each row/time-step it has arrived, plus a dedicated count column
values.result_cells: the rightmost green cell in each row states the receiver's current cumulative-acknowledgment number, which becomes the ACK value sent to the sender

content.key_idea: A receiver's cumulative acknowledgment only advances when messages arrive contiguously from m1 onward, so replicas with the same total message count can still report different ack values.
content.reading_order: left to right, top to bottom through panels (a) to (e); within each, down the four receiver rows to the green count column

palette.used_for: pale yellow fill of the message-list cells (m1..m8) in each receiver's row
pale green fill of the cumulative-acknowledgment count column

style.arrows: none, the table itself carries the message-arrival information

encoding.color_means: yellow = a received message's row entry; green = the derived cumulative-acknowledgment count for that receiver at that time-step
encoding.line_style_means: plain black table grid lines only; no arrows are used, since the table itself carries the message-arrival information
encoding.state_means: the same 4-row table is redrawn once per time-step, so a receiver's state is simply how many of its yellow message cells are filled in that frame
encoding.marker_means: no numeric markers beyond the message labels m1..m8 themselves and the letter captions (a)-(e) naming each time-step
encoding.emphasis: the green count column is the one cell every reader's eye is drawn to each frame, since it is the value the receiver actually acts on (the ACK it sends)
reusable_patterns: identical small table replayed frame by frame, with newly-arrived values filling previously blank cells and a derived summary column recomputed each frame
weaknesses: five near-identical tables packed into one figure require close side-by-side comparison to spot exactly which cells changed between consecutive time-steps

evidence: Each row in Figure 2 describes a sorted list of messages received at each replica
R22 has received messages m1 to m5, and thus updates its cumulative acknowledgment to 5
R21 and R23 have received messages m8 and m6 respectively, they are missing m5

summary: Picsou lets replicated state machines communicate efficiently by having each receiver report a single cumulative-acknowledgment number instead of acknowledging every message. This worked-example figure replays the same small table, one row per receiver (R21-R24) plus a green count column, across five time-steps. At time-step 1 every list and count is empty. By time-step 2, R21, R22 and R23 have each received one message, but only R21's (m1) is contiguous from the start, so only its count advances to 1. At time-step 3 an internal broadcast delivers m1-m4 to everyone, bringing every count to 4. At time-step 4 each receiver gains one more message, yet only R22's new message (m5) extends its contiguous prefix, so only R22's count reaches 5 while R21 and R23 stay at 4 despite holding later messages m8 and m6. Finally, time-step 5's broadcast fills every row with all eight messages, so every count reaches 8.
summary_zh: 该图用五个时间步重放同一张表，展示Picsou接收方如何计算累计确认数：只有连续收到的消息才能推进计数，如t4时R22因收到m5使前缀连续而计数达5，R21、R23虽收到更靠后的m8、m6但计数仍停在4，t5全部到齐后计数才统一到8。
